text:
eric (PM): @here quick heads-up — Hosted API streaming + tool-calling v3 is GA tomorrow 10:00am PT. Docs and migration notes: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/streaming-toolcall-v3. Please skim if you own SDKs, integrations, or any routing/ingress hooks. TL;DR: new streaming protocol with chunked function-call frames, improved retry semantics, and better backpressure handling.

deploy-bot: release scheduled: 2026-03-24T17:00Z. Plan: hosted-prod-canary -> staged rollout -> hosted-prod.

maria (eng-runtime): rollout plan: 1% canary for 30m, 10% for 1h, then full if metrics look good. We'll watch p99 latency, error budget, and frame-parse errors. Ping me for immediate rollback.

alex (devex): SDK releases published: @redwood/sdk-js@v3.0.0 and @redwood/sdk-py 3.0.0. Note: streaming frame header renamed to `rw-frame`. We included a migration shim but recommend upgrading. Example client snippet and changelog in the docs.

sasha (ops): Heads-up on infra: default per-connection keepalive semantics changed — customers with custom rate-limits should review their configs. During rollout we'll enforce a temporary throttle at 2k rps per org to protect queues.

jen (CEO): Huge congrats to everyone on the push! :tada: This is a big product milestone for our Hosted API.

maria (eng-runtime): Also: old endpoint `/v1/streaming` (no tool-calls) is deprecated. Deprecation window: 90 days. Migration guide includes a side-by-side example and an automated header shim for 30 days.

kevin (support): Can someone drop a short blurb I can paste into support replies? I'll prepare a playbook with common Qs + canned responses.

alex (devex): Added troubleshooting checklist to the docs (link in doc page). Quick curl example for validation:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\``https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream-toolcall\\`` 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-4x-open","input":"search for redwood inference docs"}'
```
New frame sample: `{"type":"tool_call","name":"search","args":{"q":"redwood inference"}}` — clients should parse incremental frames and hydrate tool outputs as they arrive.

sasha (ops): Creating an alert: streaming-frame-errors > 0.5% sustained for 5m -> page oncall. Also adding dashboard tiles for frame latency and parse-failure rate.

maria (eng-runtime): Note: embeddings-only and non-streaming customers unaffected by this rollout. Any customers on Dedicated with custom model pinning — we will not switch them without explicit approval.

kevin (support): Thanks — I'll draft the public-facing release note and internal triage doc, will share in #support in ~30m.

alex (devex): One more: we've added a small compatibility guide in the SDKs for reconnect/backoff best-practices.

eric (PM): Thanks all — if you have blockers ping me or @maria directly. We'll post a short announcement for external customers after the 10am PT go/no-go.

deploy-bot: Release started: canary deployment in progress. Job: r-20260324-streaming-v3-canary.
